answer: What keeps this honest is beacon chain sync committee signature proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 404 pays 5656 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the haven here is verification, the pigment of cost is what stops the farm, and the willow of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
